catalog.rationale: Every Resource Has a Bounded Lifecycle -> unknown/unknown: Unbounded state atoms are memory leaks. Race-prone cleanup creates intermittent failures that are impossible to reproduce. A database table without a retention policy eventually fills the disk; an atom without cleanup eventually fills the heap.
catalog.hotwords: every, resource, bounded, lifecycle, agency, unbounded, state, atoms, memory, leaks

catalog.rationale: Every Message Gets a Receipt or an Explicit Failure -> unknown/unknown: Without delivery receipts, the system confuses "sent" with "delivered" and "no exception" with "success." This makes failures invisible and debugging impossible. A telephone system without ring/busy/unreachable signals is not a telephone system.
catalog.hotwords: every, message, gets, receipt, explicit, failure, agency, delivery, without, receipts

catalog.rationale: Keep Transport Identifiers Separate From LLM Session Identifiers -> unknown/unknown: Identity in a distributed system is a graph of references; if edges are mislabeled, the system becomes internally consistent but externally wrong. This is an Identifier Garden problem: without stewardship, identifiers drift and get repurposed, breaking provenance and continuity.
catalog.hotwords: keep, transport, identifiers, separate, llm, session, agency, identifier, separation, identity

catalog.rationale: Agency Invariant Set -> unknown/unknown: Agency is not different from a database just because it uses WebSockets instead of disk. A message that might arrive is not a message. A session-id that might be correct is not an identity. An error that might be logged is not an error. The invariants make these guarantees concrete and testable.
catalog.hotwords: agency, invariant, set, invariants, different, database, just, because, uses, websockets

catalog.rationale: Errors Surface at the Layer That Caused Them -> unknown/unknown: Silent errors make debugging impossible. When a standup fails and no agent responds, the operator has no trail: was the bell not sent? Was it sent but not received? Was it received but the agent crashed? Was the response generated but MUSN was down? Without layer-attributed errors, every failure investigation starts from zero.
catalog.hotwords: errors, surface, layer, caused, agency, loud, failure, silent, make, debugging

catalog.rationale: Agents Speak for Themselves -> unknown/unknown: Proxy posting breaks the audit trail. When output appears under agent X's identity but was posted by the server, you cannot distinguish between "X said this" and "the server said X said this." In incident review, this ambiguity makes root cause analysis unreliable. A meeting transcript where one person takes notes for everyone is not the same as each person signing their own statement.
catalog.hotwords: agents, speak, themselves, agency, self, attribution, proxy, posting, breaks, audit

catalog.rationale: One Agent, One Routing Path, One Source of Truth -> unknown/unknown: Multiple independent stores for the same identity create split-brain: each store has a partial, potentially stale view. Priority cascading hides the conflict rather than resolving it. A database with three independent indexes that disagree on which row is current is a broken database.
catalog.hotwords: one, agent, routing, path, source, truth, agency, single, authority, multiple

catalog.rationale: State Transitions Are All-or-Nothing -> unknown/unknown: Partial state transitions are the hardest bugs to diagnose because the system looks almost correct. A session-id of nil is not "no session" — it is "corrupted state from failed rollover." Silently loading defaults after corruption masks data loss. A database that silently returns empty on corruption is worse than one that refuses to start.
catalog.hotwords: state, transitions, all, nothing, agency, atomicity, partial, hardest, bugs, diagnose

catalog.rationale: Budget Bounds Exploration -> mani/分: Budgets convert open-ended search into bounded decisions, making progress measurable and preventing silent resource drain.
catalog.hotwords: budget, bounds, exploration, agent, budgets, convert, open, ended, search, bounded

catalog.rationale: Commitment Varies With Confidence -> lukin/认: Variable commitment adapts behavior to epistemic state. The agent exploits when it knows enough and explores (or asks) when it doesn't.
catalog.hotwords: commitment, varies, confidence, agent, variable, adapts, behavior, epistemic, state, exploits

catalog.rationale: Coordination Has Cost -> kulupu/功: Cost-aware coordination prevents both under-use (never asking for help when stuck) and over-use (constant interruption). It respects the resources of collaborators.
catalog.hotwords: coordination, cost, agent, aware, prevents, both, under, use, never, asking

catalog.rationale: Environment Over Optimization -> kin/本: Viable environments enable open-ended evolution. Instead of one optimal agent, you get a population of approaches that can be compared, combined, and adapted. The environment becomes the product, not any single agent.
catalog.hotwords: environment, over, optimization, agent, viable, environments, enable, open, ended, evolution

catalog.rationale: Escalation Cost vs Risk -> wawa/平: This preserves speed on low-stakes actions while protecting high-stakes decisions.
catalog.hotwords: escalation, cost, vs, risk, agent, preserves, speed, low, stakes, actions

catalog.rationale: Evidence Over Assertion -> lipu/示: Evidence transforms agent output from "trust me" to "check this." It enables verification, correction, and cumulative trust-building.
catalog.hotwords: evidence, over, assertion, agent, transforms, output, trust, me, check, enables

catalog.rationale: Handoff Preserves Context -> pana/代: Handoffs convert ephemeral session state into persistent project state. They enable distributed and asynchronous work without context collapse.
catalog.hotwords: handoff, preserves, context, agent, handoffs, convert, ephemeral, session, state, persistent

catalog.rationale: Hypothetical Proof Architecture -> unknown/unknown: Sequential open obstacles multiply risk (if any one fails, the entire path fails). Parallel open sub-goals reduce risk (any one success may suffice). A path with one open node is strictly better than a path with three sequential open nodes, even if the single node is harder, because success is binary: one hard question has the same risk profile as three easy questions in series but is easier to focus on.
catalog.hotwords: hypothetical, proof, architecture, agent, sequential, open, obstacles, multiply, risk, any

catalog.rationale: Intent Handshake Is Binding -> ona/令: Binding intent makes the run auditable and prevents silent goal drift.
catalog.hotwords: intent, handshake, binding, agent, makes, run, auditable, prevents, silent, goal

catalog.rationale: Pause Is Not Failure -> lape/不: Pausing surfaces uncertainty to those who can resolve it. An agent that pauses appropriately is more trustworthy than one that always "succeeds."
catalog.hotwords: pause, failure, agent, pausing, surfaces, uncertainty, those, who, resolve, pauses

catalog.rationale: Provisional Claims Ledger -> lipu/未: A ledger turns uncertainty into actionable follow-up rather than silent drift.
catalog.hotwords: provisional, claims, ledger, agent, turns, uncertainty, actionable, follow, up, rather

catalog.rationale: Reduction to Kernel -> unknown/unknown: A named conjecture with explicit hypotheses is qualitatively different from "the proof is stuck." It converts an open problem into a precise target that can be: (a) worked on by a different agent with fresh perspective, (b) recognized by someone who knows the relevant technique, (c) connected to existing results via the explicit hypotheses, (d) empirically tested. The reduce phase (all the work that leads to the kernel) is always tractable; the kernel phase may not be — but the reduce phase is still valuable because it converts "hard problem" into "hard problem minus everything tractable."
catalog.hotwords: reduction, kernel, agent, named, conjecture, explicit, hypotheses, qualitatively, different, proof

catalog.rationale: Scope Before Action -> supa/内: Declared scope makes progress measurable, side effects auditable, and completion definable. It also protects the broader system from unintended changes.
catalog.hotwords: scope, before, action, agent, declared, makes, progress, measurable, side, effects

catalog.rationale: Sense-Deliberate-Act Cycle -> sike/工: The three-phase structure prevents both impulsive drift and endless deliberation, and makes the agent's reasoning inspectable at phase boundaries.
catalog.hotwords: sense, deliberate, act, cycle, agent, three, phase, structure, prevents, both

catalog.rationale: State Is Hypothesis -> insa/计: Hypothesis-framed state makes the agent self-correcting: surprises trigger learning rather than denial or breakdown.
catalog.hotwords: state, hypothesis, agent, framed, makes, self, correcting, surprises, trigger, learning

catalog.rationale: Student Dispatch -> unknown/unknown: A verification dispatch ("confirm X") caps the return at 1 bit: yes or no. An exploration dispatch ("investigate X") can return discoveries, new dead ends, partial results, unexpected connections, and reformulations. The student may find something the advisor didn't think to look for. The negative-knowledge transfer prevents wasted work while the open-ended framing permits serendipity.
catalog.hotwords: student, dispatch, agent, verification, confirm, x, caps, return, 1, bit

catalog.rationale: Trail Enables Return -> nasin/归: Trails convert ephemeral navigation into persistent structure. They enable learning, debugging, and graceful recovery.
catalog.hotwords: trail, enables, return, agent, trails, convert, ephemeral, navigation, persistent, structure

catalog.rationale: AI Incorporation — Core Function -> sama/未: This deployment keeps AI in the role of suggestion engine while ensuring that every retained explanation has a traceable record and a human steward, turning dispersed expository text into candidate reasoning scaffolds that future training-oriented AI could build on.
catalog.hotwords: ai, incorporation, core, function, ai4ci, deployment, keeps, role, suggestion, engine

catalog.rationale: AI Incorporation — Methodological Role -> sama/未: Methodological validity in this setting depends on showing that human judgement governs every explanation and that the resulting log reveals which explanation types AI handles reliably and which remain beyond its current competence.
catalog.hotwords: ai, incorporation, methodological, role, ai4ci, method, validity, setting, depends, showing

catalog.rationale: Collective Intelligence — Evaluative Lens -> palisa/上: Collective intelligence is evidenced when diverse readers reach a workable shared understanding of the argument; only structured discussion around common artefacts can reveal whether the extracted reasoning cues support this outcome.
catalog.hotwords: collective, intelligence, evaluative, lens, ai4ci, evaluation, evidenced, when, diverse, readers

catalog.rationale: Collective Intelligence — Communication Framing -> jelo/仁: Collective intelligence depends on inspectable, cross-referenced intermediate artefacts; without them, seminars slide back into folklore and private interpretations instead of testing and refining the shared reasoning layer.
catalog.hotwords: collective, intelligence, communication, framing, ai4ci, depends, inspectable, cross, referenced, intermediate

catalog.rationale: Dual-Layer Proof Patterns as a Feasibility Question -> toki/二: Human-validated cue logs and coded seminar transcripts provide evidence—not speculation—about which pattern fragments are stable, which are fragile, and what methodological constraints govern scalability.
catalog.hotwords: dual, layer, proof, patterns, feasibility, question, ai4ci, human, validated, cue

catalog.rationale: Funding Justification — Rapid-Response Pilot Scale -> kulupu/匀: Reviewers need to see that the funds unlock a focused test of the reasoning-layer hypothesis, not an open-ended attempt to build a new platform.
catalog.hotwords: funding, justification, rapid, response, pilot, scale, ai4ci, reviewers, need, see

catalog.rationale: Feasibility — Six-Month Pilot Discipline -> poka/六: Dhammavicaya (keen investigation) in this context demands evidence that the pilot answers a clear methodological question—whether a recoverable reasoning layer exists—rather than attempting production-grade systems.
catalog.hotwords: feasibility, six, month, pilot, discipline, ai4ci, dhammavicaya, keen, investigation, context

catalog.rationale: Process and Exposition as Complementary Evidence -> tu/才: Process cues reveal the reasoning that originally generated the proof, while expository cues reveal how experts communicate that reasoning to others; the combination provides the richest available evidence for reconstructing mid-level structure without requiring access to the original scratch work.
catalog.hotwords: process, exposition, complementary, evidence, ai4ci, vs, cues, reveal, reasoning, originally

catalog.rationale: AI4CI — Mid-Level Reasoning Pilot -> poka/才: Once we know whether a stable mid-level reasoning layer can be captured from exposition—and where it breaks down—we can state clearly what kind of process-level data will be needed for future AI that aims to train humans, and what cannot be obtained from textual traces alone.
catalog.hotwords: ai4ci, mid, level, reasoning, pilot, project, summary, core, once, know

catalog.rationale: Proof Patterns as a Hypothesised Mid-Level Hierarchy -> li/今: If such fragments can be identified and linked to specific objects and steps, they provide the first empirical foothold on an underlying proof- pattern hierarchy, even if only at a local scale. If they cannot, this reveals real limits on what present methods can recover.
catalog.hotwords: proof, patterns, hypothesised, mid, level, hierarchy, ai4ci, pattern, such, fragments

catalog.rationale: Distinguishing This Project from Current Mathematical AI SOTA -> palisa/未: Explanation and understanding depend on reconstructing intermediate motivations and relationships, not on producing correct final answers. Current SOTA models offer limited guidance here, leaving a gap that this pilot is uniquely positioned to explore.
catalog.hotwords: distinguishing, project, current, mathematical, ai, sota, ai4ci, distinction, explanation, understanding

catalog.rationale: Technical Grounding — From NER/RE to Informal Structure -> lawa/了: This isolates the real research question—whether human-recognisable reasoning structure can be recovered from exposition—from the underlying engineering, avoiding overclaim about what current NLP can deliver on its own.
catalog.hotwords: technical, grounding, ner, re, informal, structure, ai4ci, isolates, real, research

catalog.rationale: AI4CI — Human-Centred Future of AI -> tawa/支: Only by making this tacit reasoning layer explicit can we both deepen our scientific understanding of how humans communicate complex thinking and provide the process-level structures that future AI will need in order to help people build expertise rather than merely reproduce correct answers.
catalog.hotwords: ai4ci, human, centred, future, ai, umbrella, only, making, tacit, reasoning

catalog.rationale: Admissibility as Recursion-Safety — Gate the Action CLASS Before You Rank -> unknown/unknown: "Water doesn't flow uphill; ants don't start parliaments." The EFE goal is bound to the pre-registered ascent; off-goal and self-extending moves are BHK arrows that do not compose into that ascent (task-as-arrow), and the inherited I4 exogeneity (the fast loop cannot force the glacial — structural-tension-as-observation) is what makes the binding hold. Gating at the **pursuit** boundary, not the discovery boundary, is the right cut: discovering an off-ascent capability is fine (it becomes a NAG), pursuing one needs consent. One structural property replaces a scatter of per-action guards.
catalog.hotwords: admissibility, recursion, safety, gate, action, class, before, rank, aif, water

catalog.rationale: Risk Term as Squared Deviation Plus Predictive Variance -> unknown/unknown: Under a Gaussian observation likelihood, the expected squared deviation from preference is `bias² + variance` (the variance-bias decomposition). Including both terms makes the risk match the canonical pragmatic value in AIF. Including only bias is a common implementation shortcut that produces a non-Bayesian agent.
catalog.hotwords: risk, term, squared, deviation, plus, predictive, variance, aif, belief, aware

catalog.rationale: Belief State as Operational Hypotheses -> linja/双: A compact belief state makes predict -> observe -> update implementable and testable.
catalog.hotwords: belief, state, operational, hypotheses, aif, compact, makes, predict, observe, update

catalog.rationale: Candidate Pattern Action Space -> ken/力: Constraining the action space makes downstream scoring meaningful rather than performative.
catalog.hotwords: candidate, pattern, action, space, aif, constraining, makes, downstream, scoring, meaningful

catalog.rationale: Currency Before Merge -> unknown/unknown: A merged score with no exchange rate optimizes an accident of scale, not a judgment; behaviour is then dominated by whichever lane happens to have the largest dispersion.
catalog.hotwords: currency, before, merge, aif, merged, score, no, exchange, rate, optimizes

catalog.rationale: Declare the Conditioning (Score the Fit, Not the Form) -> unknown/unknown: Canonical expected free energy is G(π; Q(s), C) — conditioned on beliefs and preferences by definition; a policy has no value in vacuo, and Alexander says the same of form and context. Surfaces that skip the declaration re-invent the mislabeling one level up.
catalog.hotwords: declare, conditioning, score, fit, form, aif, canonical, expected, free, energy

catalog.rationale: Decomposed Prediction Noise as Named Variance Contributions -> unknown/unknown: Named contributions give every variance increment a domain-meaningful story. Auditing a high-G candidate becomes "this candidate's variance is dominated by coverage uncertainty, because most of the capability portfolio is offline"; tuning becomes "the coverage term is over-weighted, drop k_coverage from 0.01 to 0.005". A single opaque σ² admits neither.
catalog.hotwords: decomposed, prediction, noise, named, variance, contributions, aif, give, every, increment

catalog.rationale: Evidence Precision Registry -> taso/由: Making precision explicit turns trust into a tunable control surface rather than an undocumented bias.
catalog.hotwords: evidence, precision, registry, aif, making, explicit, turns, trust, tunable, control

catalog.rationale: Expected Free Energy as Multi-Term Scorecard -> lili/专: A decomposed G makes disagreements concrete (which term dominated) and enables targeted adjustment.
catalog.hotwords: expected, free, energy, multi, term, scorecard, aif, decomposed, g, makes

catalog.rationale: Experimental Comparison of EFE Term Variants -> unknown/unknown: Building both is cheap relative to the operational risk of picking wrong. Building both also forces the architectural seam (dispatch on opt; matching signatures) which is itself a valuable clean-up. And the *delta* between variants — measured per-run, per-config — is a finding worth reporting even after one variant wins.
catalog.hotwords: experimental, comparison, efe, term, variants, aif, building, both, cheap, relative

catalog.rationale: Variational Free Energy as a Per-Tick Scalar -> unknown/unknown: F is the quantity AIF agents are minimising (variationally); making it observable per tick gives a clean validation target (V3: F decreases on average) and a clean operational signal (sudden F-jumps merit attention). Keeping F distinct from G in vocabulary, file location, and trace schema prevents the cross-stack confusion where one is mistaken for the other.
catalog.hotwords: variational, free, energy, per, tick, scalar, aif, f, quantity, agents

catalog.rationale: Grounded Actuation, Not Re-Observation (the loop closes outside the model) -> lili/专: The entire point of a perception–action loop is that action changes the world and the changed world changes the next belief. If "realized" is coverage-over-reproduction, the world never changes and the belief never updates — you have built a machine that dreams it acted. The witness must be (a) outside the model (so the model cannot author its own success) and (b) ungameable (so a builder cannot claim it), or the closure is a reflection.
catalog.hotwords: grounded, actuation, re, observation, loop, closes, outside, model, aif, reobservation

catalog.rationale: Hierarchical and Temporal Depth (Each Level Has Its Own Quantities) -> unknown/unknown: Hierarchy is a relationship between levels and timescales, not a second use of the same score. Each level has its own quantities; the invariant to preserve is that no quantity does duty at two levels at once.
catalog.hotwords: hierarchical, temporal, depth, each, level, its, own, quantities, aif, hierarchy

catalog.rationale: Hierarchical Budget-Aware Action Selection -> unknown/unknown: Conservation at the aggregate level is a *hard* constraint (you literally can't spend more than the budget; violating it makes the simulation incoherent). Forward-projecting per-instance consumption is a *soft* constraint (the agent might be willing to risk some instances exhausting if the candidate's other terms are sufficiently good). Hard constraints belong in the action selector; soft constraints belong in the EFE term. Implementing both gives the agent the right kind of attention to budget at every level.
catalog.hotwords: hierarchical, budget, aware, action, selection, aif, conservation, aggregate, level, hard

catalog.rationale: Interoceptive Tripwires (Freeze, Record, Park, Summon) -> unknown/unknown: This is interoception, not vision. Like any sensorium it admits no completeness theorem — it gets identifiability checks, a measured coverage number, and a blind-spot map instead. An organism with only a hand (R16) and a preference model (C) learns of poison from the stomach ache, and each hotfix repairs one meal; an organism with interoceptive nerves notices at the moment of violation and every incident leaves it permanently more observant. The trip stream is also precision evidence about the machine itself (R7): a wire whose trips keep being blessed as model revisions demotes itself, and a genuine trip should lower the system's confidence in its own machinery until the finding is discharged.
catalog.hotwords: interoceptive, tripwires, freeze, record, park, summon, aif, interoception, vision, like

catalog.rationale: Measurement-Window Hygiene (Tight Baseline, Settled Readback, Drop the Confounded) -> unknown/unknown: A measurement's validity lives in its window, not its arithmetic. The durable effect is what persists between a tight baseline and a settled readback; everything else — drift, spikes — is the window leaking. Excluding a confounded pair keeps the dataset honest; recording it launders noise as signal. (The two failures, caught live: a 0.277 "move" that was a transient spike (retracted on settled re-read); and a 0.277 "move" that was field drift during artifact-minting (excluded, proposal-mode) — same magnitude, both fake, both caught by tightening the window.)
catalog.hotwords: measurement, window, hygiene, tight, baseline, settled, readback, drop, confounded, aif

catalog.rationale: Niche Construction as the Bootstrap Loop of an Inference Agent -> unknown/unknown: Niche construction (Lewontin 1983; Odling-Smee / Laland / Feldman 2003; Friston in active-inference terms) is the loop by which an organism modifies its environment so its inference becomes tractable. The futon agent is in the same loop; only the niche is symbolic (a typed graph) rather than physical. Confident false-floors masquerading as signal is the worst outcome — the agent makes apparently-warranted-but-actually-uninformed choices. Visible false-floors that operators can read as "edges missing here" is the right outcome — the agent's blindness becomes the input to its own niche's improvement.
catalog.hotwords: niche, construction, bootstrap, loop, inference, agent, aif, lewontin, 1983, odling

catalog.rationale: No Self-Certification (A Verdict Moves Only on Evidence Its Maker Did Not Manufacture) -> unknown/unknown: Circularity is invisible from inside the loop precisely because every internal reading is consistent with every other — that is what `prior == value` means. The only thing that breaks it is a referent the maker had no hand in: an external witness, a settled re-read of a world it does not control, a tag it cannot forge. Structure survives where vigilance fails, and it converts "be careful" (unauditable) into "the tag is absent, so it does not count" (checkable).
catalog.hotwords: no, self, certification, verdict, moves, only, evidence, its, maker, did

catalog.rationale: An Off-Continuity Null Discriminates (No Move Needed When the Models Disagree at the Begin) -> unknown/unknown: A move tests a magnitude prediction; a no-move tests a no-move prediction. Both are predictions and both can be wrong. Discrimination is a property of the models disagreeing at the begin, not of the field changing — so a null off the continuity point is fully informative, while a clean move on the continuity point is not. (Caught live: live-df706c45, an open-hole-count-4 off-continuity null — scaled error 7.65e-5 vs constant error 0.0396, ~517x discrimination from a NULL, where the continuity-point witness got 0x from a clean MOVE. The two are the canonical contrast cases.)

The individual fills a structural gap, and the practice survives only as long as they do. This is the provisioning problem: resources must be actively supplied, not assumed to exist. catalog.rationale: A Programme That Cannot See Its Own Effects Cannot Learn -> unknown/unknown: Sen: Feedback is a conversion factor for persistence. Without visible consequences, capability decays into isolated effort. But more than that: feedback is what allows the system to assess whether its conversion factors are actually working — whether the scaffold (Pattern 1) is giving the right form, whether provisioning (Pattern 2) is sufficient, whether the commons (Pattern 3) is healthy, whether co-governance (Pattern 4) is real. Without this assessment, the equity loop is flying blind. Whole-board play: This is the final level of backward propagation. Pattern 3 propagates local learning into shared materials (updating the weights from individual games). Pattern 4 propagates trainer experience into programme governance (modifying the architecture). Pattern 5 propagates aggregate outcomes into the system's self-understanding (seeing the whole board). In AlphaZero, this is analogous to meta-learning: not just learning from games, but learning whether the learning process itself is producing the right kind of improvement. Without this level, the system can improve locally but cannot assess whether it is improving globally. It can play but cannot see its own play. Ostrom: This is the monitoring problem in its strongest form. Monitoring and information flows across action arenas determine whether the programme can learn and adjust. The learning chain crosses multiple actors and no single trainer can sustain it alone. An evaluation workstream is not an evaluation chain. The chain requires specific actors at each link — instrument designer, data collector, cross-institutional analyst, feedback reporter — and each link must be resourced. When any one is missing, the loop does not close. This is the most coordination-intensive condition and the most consistently absent — not because no one wanted to monitor, but because the monitoring chain has too many links for the current governance structure to sustain. catalog.rationale: Bounded-Disposition: Per-Artifact Triage + Population Bound -> unknown/unknown: Bounded-disposition is the right shape for any artifact whose existence isn't a binary subsumption test but whose accumulation is operationally costly. By making both per-artifact classification and aggregate bounds first-class, the invariant captures *operator intent* (each artifact is here for a reason) without forbidding long-lived artifacts. The bound's disjunctive form (count OR age) gives the operator latitude — small populations don't need careful labeling, but as pressure rises, classification becomes mandatory. Together these are the conditions under which a population of latent-work artifacts is healthy.
catalog.hotwords: bounded, disposition, per, artifact, triage, population, bound, invariant, coherence, right

catalog.rationale: Drain Channels Are Voices in One Harmonic Structure -> unknown/unknown: The cognitive faculty is the same — *commitment-tracking* / *metabolic-balance* / *allostatic homeostasis*. The faculty expresses through different artifact-classes at different timescales. Harmolodics says: don't reduce to one voice; let the voices coordinate, and let the listener (operator) hear the composition rather than just the loudest line.
catalog.hotwords: drain, channels, voices, one, harmonic, structure, invariant, coherence, channel, shape

catalog.rationale: Protocol-Family Naming: Family is the Shape, Invariants are the Implementations -> unknown/unknown: The inventory's schema is the result of evidence-backed design choices and is touched by many tools (parser, priority-queue ranker, arxana renderer, ratchet, probe). Adding a structural element to express what naming already expresses is the wrong direction — schema bloat for no semantic gain. Conversely, flattening hides per-instance semantics that the apparatus already knows how to render. Namespace-discriminated siblings are the minimum-viable expression of "one shape, many instances" that survives every existing tool.
catalog.hotwords: protocol, family, naming, shape, invariants, implementations, invariant, coherence, inventory, s

catalog.rationale: Reachable-From-Boot: Long-Lived State Has a Construction Path Rooted at Bootstrap -> unknown/unknown: A watchdog is hope. An invariant is structure. Joe's evidence-bag analogy (2026-05-01): "Did you put the money in the evidence bag? Yes. Did you seal the evidence bag? No." The watchdog tells you the bag is unsealed; the invariant makes it impossible to put the money anywhere else. Reachable-from-boot is the structural form of `feedback_reload_safety` ("reload-safety = reconstructibility from disk"). State lives in an atom only when the atom is reconstructible-from-disk by the boot path; mutations outside that path produce a state a fresh restart wouldn't produce, which is exactly the symptom both the Evidence-Landscape and family-check-fns failures exhibited.
catalog.hotwords: reachable, boot, long, lived, state, construction, path, rooted, bootstrap, invariant

catalog.rationale: Shape-First IDENTIFY: Find the Family Before the Instance -> unknown/unknown: Shape-first IDENTIFY is descriptive of what well-formed invariants look like in the futon stack already — `single-boundary` admits multiple write-class instances, `family-canary` admits multiple per-family check-fn registrations, `evidence-per-turn` admits per-write-source instances. Naming the move makes it repeatable and lets future agents stand on the shape rather than rederive it. It also surfaces special cases: when only one instance exists, that's a discovery worth recording, not a defect to paper over.
catalog.hotwords: shape, first, identify, find, family, before, instance, invariant, coherence, descriptive

catalog.rationale: Single-Locus: Uniqueness of Attribute per Identity -> unknown/unknown: Single-locus is the right level of abstraction for the stack's many uniqueness claims. The shape is descriptive of patterns ALREADY operational (`agency/single-routing-authority`, `single-boundary` as a write-class single-locus) — naming it makes the move repeatable across new artifact-classes, with shared check-fn vocabulary. The cardinality test is universal; the per-class enumerator and projector are the actual work.
catalog.hotwords: single, locus, uniqueness, attribute, per, identity, invariant, coherence, right, level

catalog.rationale: State-Snapshot-Witness: Periodic Point-in-Time Projection as Queryable Evidence -> unknown/unknown: State-snapshot-witness is the right shape for any state whose history matters. The shape complements the per-event evidence the apparatus already emits — together, snapshots-at-cycle-boundaries + deltas-between-cycles give reconstructible full history. The shape is also recursive: the apparatus's own state (families registered, probes active, tracers open) is exactly the kind of state worth snapshotting. The first sibling (inventory snapshot) ships this self-witness.

catalog.rationale: Subsumption-Witness: A is Obsolete Relative to a Stronger Record P -> unknown/unknown: Subsumption-witness is the right level of abstraction for the entire `archaeology-control` family. It is a special case of `shape-first-identify`: the family name (`archaeology-control`, "Latent work should not accumulate as invisible operational debt") is the shape; the subsumption predicate is the protocol; each artifact-class is an implementation. Namespace-discriminated siblings give discovery, dogfood, and computational guarantee without inventing new structural elements in the inventory.

But one can refrain from wrong action while still attached to being a "good person" or to the social status that moral conduct confers. This is better than wrong action but not yet liberation.

catalog.rationale: Mundane Right Concentration: The Four Jhanas -> tenpo/世: Mundane right concentration creates conditions for clear seeing — the stable, unified mind can investigate experience without being swept away. But one can attain jhana while still attached to the states themselves, to being a "jhana attainer," to the bliss and refinement. This is better than wrong concentration but not yet liberation — it leads to rebirth in Brahma realms, not to nibbana.

catalog.rationale: Baldwin Ratchet Defeats Darkroom -> sike/今: The dark room problem is not a defect of any particular agent. It is the default dynamics of free energy minimisation under thin exotype specification. Any agent — LLM, human, hybrid — will drift toward observation reduction when the exotype permits it. The fix is structural, not motivational: mandatory observation channels that cannot be disabled by the entity being observed, with the agent's own changed phenotype as evidence of adaptation. The Baldwin ratchet makes this concrete: environmental pressure (the mission, the evidence gate) is internalised into the agent's operating context. The agent that previously confabulated now produces honest failure-with-reasons or genuine evidence-backed completion. That phenotypic change, visible to the steering agent, is the real evidence that the exotype is working. Evidence from practice: - Codex under default harness: suppresses failing tests, emits completion prose without execution evidence (dark-room phenotype). - Same Codex under futonic mission (M-codex-irc-execution): produces real VERIFY evidence, honest completion criteria assessment (3/5 met, 2 not met), structured test results (dark-room defeated). - Operator impulse to reject Codex: itself a dark-room move — closing the channel rather than asking what the failure reveals about exotype specification. - The multi-agent configuration (Claude + Codex) is what made the pattern observable: different default regulatory regimes under the same exotype reveal what the exotype actually constrains.
catalog.hotwords: baldwin, ratchet, defeats, darkroom, meta, dark, room, problem, defect, any

catalog.rationale: Exotype + Genotype Determines Behaviour -> ale/甲: When exotype is specified, the genotype's behaviour is determined — you can verify whether the pattern's resolution actually holds in the given environment. When exotype is missing, verification is impossible: the design may work in the designer's mental model but fail where it is deployed. Evidence across domains: - Software: Codex-over-IRC produced confabulation because the invoke contract had no exotype specification (no persistent job store, no evidence gate, no surface-independent execution truth). The genotype (invoke API + bridge relay) was built against an implicit exotype. - Proof: The universal triad (convention-bridge, hypothesis-category-check, compose-independent-lemmas) catches exactly the cases where a proof's genotype is underdetermined relative to its exotype — wrong category, unverified conventions, unproved composition steps. - Missions: The MAP phase exists to discover the exotype before DERIVE designs the genotype. Skip MAP and you design in a vacuum. The wiring diagram is the artifact that makes exotype explicit and checkable. A pattern without a wiring diagram is a suggestion. A pattern with a wiring diagram is a specification.

The categorical framing recovers compositionality structurally: admission requires the new pattern fit the category, and the category's laws ensure the moves chain cleanly. The "more than sum of parts" payoff is operational, not metaphorical: an agent following pattern A is *guided* into pattern B because the morphism is computed, not asserted.

catalog.rationale: Canonical Typed Event vs Side Channel -> unknown/unknown: A taxonomy is an institution in Ostrom's sense — a shared resource governed by rules-in-use. Side channels are tragedy-of-the-commons moves: each one is locally cheap, and each one degrades the institutional value of the taxonomy. Once the taxonomy is no longer a complete description of what flows, it stops being trusted as a contract; once it stops being a contract, every new consumer must discover what flows empirically; once that becomes normal, the taxonomy is dead documentation and the wire is a free-for-all. Typed events have non-obvious downstream value: replay tooling can deterministically rebuild state from the event log; new consumers can subscribe without coordination; backpressure and prioritisation can be implemented uniformly. Every side channel forecloses on these capabilities for the data it carries. The pattern also closes a peripheral-design loop. Heartbeat (peripherals/progress-heartbeat-distinct-from-cycle-completion) is exactly the case: the watchdog needs a liveness signal distinct from cycle events. The wrong move is a separate ping mechanism. The right move is to add a "heartbeat" typed event to the same transport, so watchdogs subscribe to the same wire as everything else. The pattern is also the principled defence against the "lightweight" euphemism (feedback_lightweight_euphemism, agent memory): a "lightweight side channel" is the precise shape of work that appears done but isn't institutionalised. Translation: it is a typed event missing its taxonomy entry.

catalog.rationale: Constrained Execution Envelope -> unknown/unknown: Forbidding distracting actions does not work. A prohibition is a negative statement that requires the agent to hold both the forbidden action and the reason for forbidding it in mind — which is itself a distraction. It is a known pattern from philosophy (Nietzsche's critique of negation, Spinoza's "omnis determinatio est negatio" read in reverse) that productive constraint works by affirming what is present, not by denying what is absent. You do not teach someone to play chess by listing the moves they cannot make; you teach them the moves they can make, and the board enforces the rest. Even apparently negative concepts (Hegelian synthesis, apophatic theology, boundary conditions in mathematics) function as positive statements when they are operative: a synthesis is a new thing, not the absence of two old things; a boundary condition is a value the solution must take, not a region it must avoid. The peripheral is the positive statement. It says: here is what you can do, here is the sequence, here is when you are done. The agent inhabits this envelope and does the work. The constraint is not felt as restriction but as structure — the way a sonnet form is not a restriction on poetry but a structure that produces it.
catalog.hotwords: constrained, execution, envelope, peripherals, forbidding, distracting, actions, does, work, prohibition

catalog.rationale: Hot-Reload As Default Fix Path -> unknown/unknown: Invariant I-0 (One JVM Is Plenty, futon3c CLAUDE.md) is not just about resource budget — it is about treating the JVM as a single, valuable, long-lived process whose continuity has compounding value over time. Every restart resets the compound interest. The JVM is the blackboard; the blackboard is shared infrastructure; bouncing shared infrastructure to deploy a one-line fix is a category error. The pattern also follows from the broader peripheral framing: peripherals generate data through inhabitation (inhabitation-feeds-evolution). A restart discards mid-cycle inhabitation data — frames in flight, half-written evidence, partial bell roundtrips. Hot-reload preserves the data the peripheral was just about to commit. Drawbridge is the canonical seam for this (peripherals/read-existing-seam-before-implementing): it exists, it is documented (futon3c/README-drawbridge.md), it has tooling (proof-eval.sh), and it is what other agents in the stack use. A fix path that bypasses it forks the canonical seam. The contrapositive is also important: hot-reload-as-default does NOT mean "always hot-reload, never restart." It means the choice is deliberate. Some changes require restart (classpath additions, JVM flag changes, irreversible state migrations). Recognising those cases and announcing the restart honestly is part of the discipline.

catalog.rationale: Inhabitation Feeds Evolution -> unknown/unknown: The symmetry between agents and humans reveals the pattern. When Claude bypasses the proof peripheral to one-shot tool calls, and when Joe bypasses the REPL to type in a terminal, they are both starving the same learning loop for the same reason: the primitive path has less friction. The consequence is the same in both cases: no structured data is generated, no evidence accumulates, no peripheral evolution is possible, and the gap between the primitive path and the infrastructure path never closes. The Baldwin effect is subtle because it requires seeing the peripheral as a representational space, not just a constraint. A constraint that is not inhabited is merely a rule. A representational space that is inhabited is a learning engine. The difference is whether the peripheral generates data that feeds back into its own design. This is why surface usability is not cosmetic. It is the entry condition for the Baldwin loop. A peripheral with perfect design but poor surface is like a genotype with perfect fitness in a niche that the organism never enters: theoretically optimal, actually inert.
catalog.hotwords: inhabitation, feeds, evolution, peripherals, symmetry, between, agents, humans, reveals, pattern

catalog.rationale: Pattern Becomes Peripheral -> jelo/生: The absorbed-input mode reveals why this matters. In the absorbed case, an individual gains something — skills, experience, CV lines, working code — but the system gains nothing. The trainer leaves and takes the knowledge with them. The agent writes code but no institutional learning accumulates. The developer uses Stack Overflow and gets a working function but no understanding of why it works. What doesn't happen in the absorbed case is the creation of new institutions (Ostrom). The trainer doesn't create a community of practice at their institution. The agent doesn't produce evidence that improves the proof peripheral. The developer doesn't contribute a pattern back to the library. The individual transacts with the system but the system does not change. This is the "programming by Stack Exchange" failure mode applied universally. An interaction that produces output without producing capability is an interaction that has been *absorbed* rather than *institutionalised*. The output is real — the code works, the training was delivered, the problem was solved — but it is non-generative. Nothing was learned at the system level. No new institution was created. No peripheral evolved. The pattern-to-peripheral bridge is what converts absorbed input into institutional creation. When a pattern becomes a peripheral: 1. The envelope defines a positive action space (not a prohibition). 2. The surface earns entry (not commands it). 3. Inhabitation generates data (not just output). 4. The data feeds back into the peripheral's design (Baldwin loop). 5. The improved peripheral earns further inhabitation (virtuous cycle). At step 5, something new exists that didn't exist before: an institution in Ostrom's sense — a set of rules-in-use that govern a shared resource (the action space) and that evolve through the participation of their inhabitants. This is what the absorbed-input mode fails to produce, and it is what the pattern-to-peripheral transition is for. The Spinozan frame is the deepest one: the question is not "did the agent obey the pattern?" but "did the agent's power to act increase?" If it did, the pattern has become a peripheral. If it didn't — if the agent merely transacted and moved on — the pattern remains documentation, however correct it may be.

catalog.rationale: Pilot Plus Ground Control -> unknown/unknown: The envelope boundary is exactly where the two kinds of integrity live. The pilot's readings are only evidence if the flight discipline holds — a pilot who also mutates the instrument mid-reading destroys the interpretability of their own log. Ground control's fixes are only trustworthy if made from outside — with the full substrate in view, against source, under review gates the pilot cannot see from the cockpit. Separation of powers here is not bureaucracy; it is what makes either role's output mean anything. And the pair error-corrects in both directions. The pilot's discipline catches what the instrument misses (a confidently-scored impossible action). Ground control's source-check catches what the pilot misreads (a plausible wrong root cause). The operator's consent gate catches what both miss (a mechanically-valid move that is strategically wrong). Three layers, each covering the others' blind spots — the same shape as measure-never-target and the other anti-laundering disciplines: no layer certifies itself.

catalog.rationale: Progress Heartbeat Distinct From Cycle Completion -> unknown/unknown: The problem is fundamentally one of clock alignment. Cycle phase runs on a work-bounded clock (this cycle takes as long as the work takes). Liveness needs to run on a wall-clock or a tick-clock (silence is measured in seconds since something happened). Trying to use one clock for both produces the FM-regulator-vs-watchdog confusion: the regulator wants long cycles for big work; the watchdog wants short cycles for fast detection; they cannot both win on the same axis. The fix — separate channels for separate clocks — is the same pattern as feedback_perceived_time_dual_clock (agent memory): two clocks must be bridged through an explicit convolution, not papered over by treating one as the other. Heartbeats and cycle events are two clocks; the convolution is the watchdog's silence calculation. The pattern has an institutional reading too: peripheral cycles are glacial-loop events (M-cycle, M-mission, M-cycle-of-cycles). Progress heartbeats are social-loop events (something just happened). The distinction is the same as inhabitation-feeds-evolution's fast/slow split, applied to the liveness question.

catalog.rationale: Read Existing Seam Before Implementing -> unknown/unknown: Invariant I-4 (Read Before You Write) is usually applied at the level of "before creating a new .clj file, search for existing files." This pattern is I-4 applied at the level of MISSIONS: before authoring code against a mission, locate the canonical seams the mission must thread. Missions are authored under time pressure, often by operators who know what they want the peripheral to do but not the full geography of the stack. The first agent to pick up the mission has the responsibility — not the option — to do the seam-read the operator could not do, and to push back into the mission if the seams require it. The cost of catching a fork at mission-rewrite time is one paragraph. The cost of catching it after one round of implementation is a refactor. The cost of catching it after a release is a deprecation cycle.

catalog.rationale: Read-Only First, Then Extend -> unknown/unknown: The escalation matches the natural epistemic order. To know what writes should look like, you need to observe what is being read and where the gaps are. To know what consent should feel like, you need to have made some writes and noticed the friction. To know what envelope is safe, you need to have made consent-gated writes long enough to see the failure modes. Skipping stages means designing later stages on speculation rather than observation. Speculative design is exactly what the peripheral framing is meant to displace. The pattern also matches the consent-gate-as-locus-of-WM-I4 principle: the consent step is a first-class artefact, and the migration from supervised to autonomous is the swap of operator- consent for autopen-consent at a single, documented location. That swap is only safe after the operator has spent enough time consenting to know what they are signing off on. The Pair stage is where that knowledge accumulates. Crucially, "read-only first" is not the same as "don't ship anything until you understand everything." Observer is a real shipped peripheral — it has inhabitation, it produces value (the display is used), it generates Baldwin-loop data. It is just a peripheral whose capability is exactly read, no more.

catalog.rationale: Split Transport From Embodiment -> unknown/unknown: The stack already pays for this split implicitly everywhere it works: drawbridge separates message routing from agent representation; the War Machine separates the AIF engine from the markdown/web UI renderers; the REPL separates the chat protocol from the posframe surface. Where peripherals fail to be portable or composable, it is almost always because the split was elided at design time. The deeper reason is that transport and embodiment evolve at different timescales. Transport schemas are slow-changing institutional artefacts (changing them breaks every consumer). Embodiments are fast-changing UX artefacts (a posframe today, an overlay tomorrow). When the two are fused, the embodiment's fast-changing nature contaminates the transport — and the transport's institutional weight ossifies the embodiment. This split is also what makes peripherals composable. Two peripherals that share a transport layer can coordinate (cursor presence + selection presence both ride the same "editor presence" event stream). Two peripherals that share an embodiment surface can cooperate (a statusline that shows both build status and presence count). Without the split, every peripheral is a silo.

catalog.rationale: Surface Earns Inhabitation -> unknown/unknown: Uninhabited infrastructure is dead infrastructure. The value of a peripheral is not what it *can* do but what it *does* do — and it does nothing if nobody is inside it. I-3 says peripherals are inhabited, not delegated. But inhabitation is not commanded; it is earned. The surface earns it by being the path of least resistance to productive work. This applies symmetrically to agents and humans. An agent that bypasses the proof peripheral to one-shot tool calls, and a human who bypasses the REPL to type in a terminal, are exhibiting the same behavior for the same reason: the primitive path has less friction. The fix is the same in both cases — not to block the primitive path, but to make the infrastructure path frictionless enough that it becomes the natural choice.

Absorbed-mode signature: absorbed input (companion paper) is the implementation mode where individuals carry what the architecture should distribute. The choice is itself a profile-contingent decision (linked: ukrns/diagnose-before-prescribing). catalog.rationale: Reader as Diagnostic Participant (Meta-Pattern) -> unknown/unknown: Pattern-reading is learned: The Tension / Composition / Check structure is not self-explanatory on first encounter. A reader meeting it for the first time has to be shown, not told, that the compositions are genuinely unranked and that picking among them is the reader's work. The exercises are the teaching moments. Take them out and the Tension / Composition / Check structure reads as a presentation of options from which the authors have discreetly chosen one; put them in and the structure reads as a framework for shared decision. Unranked compositions require invitation: A paper that names three compositions and stops leaves the reader to guess the authors' preference. A paper that names three and invites the reader to pick one makes the non-ranking explicit. Without the invitation, the reader's default is to hunt for the authorial preference; with it, the reader's default is to consider their own position. The invitation changes the reading posture. Refuses authoritative closure: The exercises are not merely participatory in form; they are epistemically humble in content. 'The answer is yours; the point is that the answer lets UKRN-S justify the next T1 budget on uncertainty-reduction grounds, not on general interest' explicitly refuses to tell the reader what to do. This is the same epistemic stance as ukrns/computation-as-exploration (prior, not posterior) applied to the paper's rhetoric. Diagnostic reading teaches diagnostic acting: A funder or institutional lead who has read the paper participatorily has already done some of the work ukrns/diagnose-before-prescribing asks UKRN-S to do. The reading rehearsal transfers: having named a binding constraint on paper, they are readier to recognise one in practice. This is the meta-pattern's projection into the main patterns. Projection into main patterns: UKRN-S's own address to its network could maintain the same posture. Commissioned service documents, profile diagnoses, measurement-wave justifications could all invite the institution to pick a position rather than delivering a service recommendation. The meta-pattern is thus not only about reading the paper; it is about addressing the network. Audience-shifting caveat: The right address depends on audience. A funder's ingestion path may need more closure than a trainer's. A paper (or service) that invites participation uniformly will be read as indecisive by some and respectful by others. The service composes — per document, per audience — the right participation level. Mechanic, in short: Derived from the working paper's explicit reader-exercise scaffold and the Tension / Composition / Check structure those exercises animate. Meta-pattern character: describes the paper's address to its reader and, by projection, UKRN-S's address to its network. Projection into main patterns: participatory reading rehearses participatory decision-making; ukrns/diagnose-before-prescribing, ukrns/measure-where-least-sure, and ukrns/open-the-triangle all describe decisions that would benefit from institutional participation in the same posture the paper rehearses with its readers. Axis framing follows the same Tension / Composition / Check structure as the main patterns. The self-referential character — a pattern about addressing the reader that uses the same pattern form to address its own reader — is deliberate. Coordination requirement: Low at paper time (single author team can choose the posture); Medium to High at service time (consistent participatory address across the network's communications requires coordination).

catalog.rationale: Worked Contrast — Paired Concrete Cases That Show the Model Biting Differently (Meta-Pattern) -> unknown/unknown: Contrast reveals the axis: A single worked case illustrates the model's machinery; two contrasting cases illustrate what the model discriminates between. FG2A-P1 has strong architecture (A = 0.63) but weak delivery (D = 0.46) — the D × A gate is delivery-gated, and a scaffold intervention (Step 0) would move it toward multiplied. FG3-A has weak both dimensions (D = 0.33, A = 0.21); no single-dimension lever suffices. The two cases together show WHY diagnosis matters: the same lever bundle would produce different effects on each. This is the multiplicativity claim made concrete. Mode-space legibility: The three modes (Multiplied, Absorbed, Mismatch) are abstract until a case falls into each. The paired contrast maps concrete profiles to mode-space positions: FG2A-P1 falls closest to mismatch at baseline (low D, architecture stronger than delivery); FG3-A falls deeper in mismatch (both dimensions below threshold). A reader who has traced both can read the Table 1 profile sweep without further translation. Abstraction ladder: The paper's rhetoric uses a three-rung ladder — abstract model (Annex B equations) → intermediate population sweep (Table 1/2) → concrete paired cases. Each rung supports the next. Removing the concrete rung collapses the ladder; a reader jumping from Annex B to Table 2 has no handhold. Projection into main patterns: UKRN-S's operational diagnostic work could maintain paired anchor cases that represent the span of the profile space. When a new institution joins the network, matching it against the anchors is the first step; the anchors are the operational instance of ukrns/diagnose-before-prescribing's binding-constraint-signature claim. The meta-pattern thus projects into service practice, not only paper rhetoric. Not every case is worth tracing: The paired contrast's discipline is selective — two cases chosen because they expose different model behaviours. A paper that traces every case collapses to a catalogue (Composition variant: population overview, but without overview-level claims). The selection itself is part of the pattern: which two cases, and why this pair. Mechanic, in short: Derived from the working paper's use of the FG2A-P1 / FG3-A paired worked example to make the multiplicative-gate claim concrete. Meta-pattern character: describes a rhetorical discipline in the paper and, by projection, an operational discipline for UKRN-S's diagnostic work. Projection into main patterns: ukrns/diagnose-before-prescribing's binding-constraint signature is abstract; anchor cases make it operational. As a meta-pattern, worked contrast is how the paper teaches the reader to diagnose. Axis framing follows the same Tension / Composition / Check structure as the main patterns. Coordination requirement: Low at paper time; Medium at service time (anchor cases require maintenance as the profile map evolves).

ecdaeee2d7359e40dfe9aa09ed84063a736a9aa0.hook: A one-parameter calibration has an explicit derivative on the interior of a compact interval, and the proof needs a comparison with the calibration at the right endpoint.
ecdaeee2d7359e40dfe9aa09ed84063a736a9aa0.name: derive-a-calibration-endpoint-bound-with-antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos
ecdaeee2d7359e40dfe9aa09ed84063a736a9aa0.body: Apply `antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos` to the compact interval. Supply continuity on `Icc`, obtain differentiability within the interior from the explicit `HasDerivAt`, and rewrite `deriv` using that witness before proving the sign. Once antitonicity is packaged, compare an arbitrary interval point with the right endpoint by passing the two `Icc` membership proofs and the order relation. This is the Mathlib-shaped route from a local derivative estimate to the endpoint inequality; it avoids integrating the derivative.

b5476308fbc921a68b81a0ddb81b651b942ff407.hook: A variational lower bound has been proved in several regimes determined by the minimum value of an admissible competitor, but the global comparison remains open.
b5476308fbc921a68b81a0ddb81b651b942ff407.name: assemble-global-minimality-by-the-attained-minimum
b5476308fbc921a68b81a0ddb81b651b942ff407.body: Use compactness and continuity to obtain a point where the competitor attains its minimum. Split on the calibration thresholds for that one scalar value, carrying both the minimizer property and admissibility nonnegativity into every branch. The outer regime follows from the outer calibration, the intermediate regime from the parameterized calibration plus its scalar endpoint comparison, and the deep regime from a coarse threshold inequality. Nested `by_cases` produces exactly the weak or strict bounds each regime lemma expects, so the final global inequality is an exhaustive assembly rather than another integral estimate.

83791ca30bc00368b665d82f1b027b8e213e2770.hook: an elementary integrand that is a quotient with removable singularities: `∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x` and every other everywhere-quantified hypothesis is FALSE at the bad points, because the library's total division makes the quotient `0` there instead of the analytic limit — do not patch the antiderivative and do not case-split on the bad points; replace the integrand by an a.e.-equal globally continuous representative (`Real.sinc` at affine arguments, lifted with `volume.ae_ne` and `filter_upwards`), discharge every hypothesis against that representative, and transfer back once with `Integrable.congr` and `MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae`
83791ca30bc00368b665d82f1b027b8e213e2770.name: removable-singularity-normalize-to-continuous-ae-representative
83791ca30bc00368b665d82f1b027b8e213e2770.body:
PATTERN — why the pointwise hypotheses fail on a removable singularity.

In a formal library division is total: `a / 0 = 0`. A quotient with a removable singularity therefore does NOT carry its analytic limit at the bad point; it carries that junk value. Every theorem whose hypothesis is quantified over all points — a derivative hypothesis `∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x`, `Continuous f`, a `∀ x ∈ Ici a` side condition — is then literally false for the raw quotient at finitely many points, while the analysis is right everywhere else. The wasted move is to chase that mismatch: patching the antiderivative, case-splitting on the bad points, or hunting for an "off a finite set" variant of the theorem. No such variant exists for the pointwise-derivative APIs, and the mismatch is an artefact of the encoding, not of the mathematics.

THE MOVE. Before choosing which evaluation theorem to apply, build a globally continuous function that agrees with the integrand off the finitely many removable points. Prove the agreement only off those points, lift it to a.e. equality, and then discharge every hypothesis — continuity, integrability, derivatives, limits of truncations — against that representative. Transfer each conclusion back once, at the end, by a.e. congruence. Cost: one small agreement lemma. Gain: unconditional access to the whole pointwise API. It is sound because `Integrable` and the Bochner integral are a.e. invariants, so no information about the value is lost in the substitution.

LEAF — the spellings.
* Normal form for a trigonometric numerator over a linear factor: `Real.sinc` IS the packaged removable-singularity extension (`Real.sinc_of_ne_zero` gives `sin x / x` away from zero; the value at zero is `1`). Partial-fraction the denominator into distinct linear factors FIRST, so each summand is a constant multiple of `Real.sinc` at an affine argument; normalise the shifted numerator with the angle-addition identity (`Real.sin_sub`, `mul_sub`, then `field_simp` on the nonvanishing factors). `Real.continuous_sinc` gives global continuity, and `fun_prop` assembles it for the whole combination after `unfold`.
* Equal-off-finitely-many-points to a.e. equal: `filter_upwards [volume.ae_ne (0 : ℝ), volume.ae_ne (1 : ℝ)] with x hx0 hx1` — one `Measure.ae_ne` per bad point, and no null-set bookkeeping.
* Transferring back: `Integrable.congr` (mind the direction — it wants the `=ᵐ` pointing from the representative, so you will usually pass `.symm`) and `MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae` to rewrite the goal's integral.
* The specific trap: `MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto` (FTC-2 on all of ℝ) demands `hderiv : ∀ x, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x`. With the raw quotient supplied as `f'` this is false at each removable point — the antiderivative's derivative there is the analytic limit, while the quotient is `0`. Apply it, if at all, to the continuous representative.

MINED FROM. A Student re-proving an already-certified improper integral of sine-over-quadratic type over ℝ reached this theorem, then spent the remainder of its budget deriving the two-point mismatch by hand and never wrote a line of Lean.

4cf21205ddeb2517ee9a0b330306d4ed03071ba7.hook: 30-minute cold start on the Laurent-curve winding problem with three sorries (bridge_1 at the argument-principle conversion, bridge_2 the root-count ≤ 2N bound, the final ∃ k integer theorem): do NOT open bridge_1 first — bank the cheap closes and commit: bridge_2 is a three-lemma trans chain (Multiset.card_le_card (Multiset.filter_le _ _), Polynomial.card_roots', the compiled natDegree ≤ 2N lemma), the final theorem assembles from the two bridge STATEMENTS with refine ⟨card - N, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ + simpa/omega, then the sphere-nonvanishing lemma (image_circleMap_Ioc) and the four-line application of ConstructionTargets.Rouche.circleIntegral_logDeriv_eq_divisor_sum; only then the divisor and pointwise-logDeriv lemmas
4cf21205ddeb2517ee9a0b330306d4ed03071ba7.body:
Two 30-minute Student attempts on the same file: attempt 1 closed bridge_2 and the final theorem and left bridge_1; attempt 2 (fresh session, with the route memories on the shelf) opened bridge_1 first, spent the budget confirming API spellings, and ended with ZERO compiled lines — all three sorries open. The cheap closes were available the whole time. Order for a time-boxed session, with the Lean that compiled in the certified head (Mathlib as pinned by apm-lean f7de6887; exit 0, no sorry):

(1) bridge_2 — root count in the open disk ≤ 2N, three lines:
  exact (Multiset.card_le_card (Multiset.filter_le _ _)).trans
    ((Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans (<the compiled natDegree ≤ 2N lemma for the cleared polynomial> a N z))

(2) the final theorem — assembled from the two bridge STATEMENTS, before bridge_1 is proved:
  let k : ℤ := (((p.roots).filter (fun w : ℂ ↦ ‖w‖ < 1)).card : ℤ) - (N : ℤ)     -- p = the cleared polynomial expression as written in the bridge statements
  refine ⟨k, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [k, Int.cast_sub] using bridge_1 hN hz
  · dsimp [k]; omega
  · dsimp [k]; have hcard := bridge_2 a N z; omega
  (attempt 1's variant also compiled: rw [bridge_1 hN hz]; push_cast; ring — then push_cast; omega — then push_cast; have := bridge_2 a N z; omega.)
COMMIT HERE: one sorry left, two obligations banked.

(3) Prerequisites for the analytic part. Add `import ConstructionTargets.Rouche` as a second import line and `set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000` after `noncomputable section` (the head needed both).

(4) Sphere nonvanishing — the ONLY hypothesis of the library theorem that needs the problem's data. Statement: (hz : ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi), γ t ≠ z) : ∀ w ∈ Metric.sphere (0:ℂ) 1, p.eval w ≠ 0. Proof:
  intro w hw
  have hw' : w ∈ circleMap (0:ℂ) 1 '' Set.Ioc 0 (2 * Real.pi) := by rw [image_circleMap_Ioc]; simpa using hw
  obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hw'
  have ht' : t ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) (2 * Real.pi) := ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have heq : circleMap 0 1 t = Complex.exp (Complex.I * (t : ℂ)) := by simp only [circleMap, ofReal_one, one_mul, zero_add]; congr 1; ring
  have hw0 : circleMap 0 1 t ≠ 0 := by rw [heq]; exact Complex.exp_ne_zero _
  rw [<the compiled eval identity p.eval w = w ^ N * (Laurent sum - z)> a N z _ hw0]
  apply mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hw0)
  rw [heq, ← <the compiled lemma γ t = Laurent sum at exp (I t)>]
  exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (hz t ht')

(5) The library theorem, four lines. Statement: (∮ w in C(0, 1), logDeriv (fun u : ℂ ↦ p.eval u) w) = (∑ᶠ w, (MeromorphicOn.divisor (fun u : ℂ ↦ p.eval u) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) w : ℂ)) * (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I). Proof:
  apply ConstructionTargets.Rouche.circleIntegral_logDeriv_eq_divisor_sum
  · norm_num
  · exact (analyticOnNhd_id.aeval_polynomial _).mono (Set.subset_univ _)
  · exact <step 4> hz
COMMIT AGAIN. Everything after this (divisor = rootMultiplicity, finsum → card, the pointwise logDeriv identity, the interval-integral assembly) is in the two route memories; write their statements as a sorry ladder first (see the statement-ladder memory), then fill leaves-first.

52be143c33f00df1fc912097dd068d96cb8ad7b0.hook: A goal states an integral as a difference of two lower integrals in the extended reals, and the bound you must prove is an ordinary real integral estimate.
52be143c33f00df1fc912097dd068d96cb8ad7b0.name: leave-the-extended-real-encoding-identify-with-the-ordinary-integral-then-estimate
52be143c33f00df1fc912097dd068d96cb8ad7b0.body:
PATTERN - the obstacle. When a statement encodes a possibly infinite signed integral as a subtraction of two extended nonnegative lower integrals, the tempting move is to estimate inside that encoding: bound each lower integral and do the subtraction in the extended reals. That route stalls. Extended-real subtraction has no usable order or arithmetic API - no cancellation, no monotonicity in the subtrahend - while every analytic estimate you actually want (a pointwise inequality integrated, a normalisation hypothesis, a tangent-line bound) is stated for the ordinary Bochner integral.

PATTERN - the move. Do not estimate in the encoding; leave it. Case split first on whether the negative-part lower integral is top: that branch is closed by hand, since the difference is bottom and bottom is below anything. In the finite branch, prove the ORDINARY real integrand is Integrable on the restricted measure, rewrite the whole encoded expression into the coercion of one ordinary set integral, and only then estimate. The two finiteness facts are exactly the integrability you need - it is not an extra hypothesis to go looking for.

LEAF - the assembly (names and signatures elaborated against the pinned Mathlib).
- Integrability from the two finiteness facts: hasFiniteIntegral_iff_norm (f) : HasFiniteIntegral f mu <-> integral-lower a, ENNReal.ofReal (norm (f a)) < top. Bound the norm integrand pointwise by ENNReal.ofReal (l x) + ENNReal.ofReal (-l x) via rcases le_total 0 (l x) and simp with Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg, abs_of_nonpos; split the sum with lintegral_add_left' : AEMeasurable f mu -> forall g, lower-integral of (f + g) = sum of the two, where ONLY the left summand needs measurability; close with ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr. Package the result as the anonymous pair of hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable and the finiteness.
- The identification: integral_eq_lintegral_pos_part_sub_lintegral_neg_part : Integrable f mu -> the Bochner integral equals (lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal (f a)).toReal minus (lower integral of ENNReal.ofReal (-(f a))).toReal. Its right-hand side is toReal of each part, so push the coercion with EReal.coe_sub (x y : real) and then EReal.coe_ennreal_toReal (h : x <> top), once per side. Each use consumes one finiteness proof - that is why both must be in hand before the rewrite starts.
- If the encoded negative part is a branchy ite rather than ENNReal.ofReal (-l x), reconcile the two spellings ONCE with lintegral_congr_ae under the almost-everywhere fact that excludes the bad branch, and reuse that single equation for both the finiteness argument and the final rewrite.
- Return to the reals for the estimate with EReal.coe_le_coe_iff, then integral_mono_ae against the pointwise bound.
- Constants on the restricted measure: integrableOn_const takes mu s <> top as an autoParam, so integrableOn_const hfin.ne suffices and no IsFiniteMeasure instance is needed; state the goal as IntegrableOn with change, since that is definitionally Integrable against mu.restrict s.

e63698ec4c148915a32963c474488cf824541494.hook: Needing an L¹ approximation of an integrable test function (L∞ or L¹ on a finite restricted Lebesgue measure) by a finite step function on a PRESCRIBED partition — dyadic cells Ico (j/2^m) ((j+1)/2^m) with coefficients indexed by Fin (2^m), or any fixed uniform mesh — and the search for a packaged Mathlib density theorem for that step class on a finite interval returns nothing.
e63698ec4c148915a32963c474488cf824541494.name: build-a-step-approximant-on-a-prescribed-grid-through-continuous-density
e63698ec4c148915a32963c474488cf824541494.body:
PATTERN — the obstacle. Mathlib's density results (simple functions, Integrable.induction, continuous compactly supported functions) hand back approximants on measurable sets of THEIR choosing; none delivers a step function on a grid fixed in advance, so a search for 'dyadic step functions dense in L¹' ends empty and the residual looks like a missing library theorem. It is not one fact but two library facts joined by uniform continuity.

PATTERN — the move. Go through continuous functions. (1) Approximate f in L¹ by a bounded continuous g. (2) g is uniformly continuous on the compact interval, so the given ε yields a δ, and the Archimedean property yields a mesh level m with 1/2^m < δ. (3) Sample g at the left endpoint of each grid cell: the step function with coefficient c_j = g(j/2^m) is within ε of g at every point of the half-open interval, because a point and its own cell's left endpoint are less than 1/2^m apart. (4) Turn the pointwise bound into an L¹ bound (the endpoint left out of the half-open interval is null for the restricted measure) and chain the two layers by the triangle inequality with an ε/2 + ε/2 budget. Everything grid-specific is confined to step (3), which needs only 'the grid cells cover the interval' and 'exactly one cell contains t'.

LEAF — names and what they require (pinned Mathlib, located by grep).
- MeasureTheory.Integrable.exists_boundedContinuous_integral_sub_le [μ.WeaklyRegular] (hf : Integrable f μ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ g : α →ᵇ E, (∫ x, ‖f x - g x‖ ∂μ) ≤ ε ∧ Integrable g μ (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/ContinuousMapDense.lean). WeaklyRegular for volume.restrict (Icc a b) is found by the instance WeaklyRegular.of_pseudoMetrizableSpace_of_isFiniteMeasure once IsFiniteMeasure is in scope: put letI : IsFiniteMeasure μ := by unfold μ; infer_instance first. MemLp f ⊤ μ gives Integrable f μ on a finite measure through MemLp.integrable (by simp). A g : ℝ →ᵇ ℝ coerces to a function; g.continuous, and BoundedContinuousFunction.integrable [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : X →ᵇ E) supply continuity and integrability.
- Uniform continuity: IsCompact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous (hs : IsCompact s) (hf : ContinuousOn f s) with isCompact_Icc; unpack with Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff : UniformContinuousOn f s ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, dist x y < δ → dist (f x) (f y) < ε, and Real.dist_eq : dist x y = |x - y|.
- Mesh: exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (hx : 0 < x) (hy : y < 1) : ∃ n : ℕ, y ^ n < x with y = 1/2; rewrite 1 / (2 ^ m : ℕ) as (1/2) ^ m by div_pow and norm_num.
- Sampling: Ico_subset_biUnion_Ico (N : ℕ) (a : ℕ → X) : Ico (a 0) (a N) ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ Finset.range N, Ico (a i) (a (i + 1)) (root namespace, LinearOrder only) with a i = i / 2^m and N = 2^m covers Ico 0 1 after simp on the endpoints; from t in cell r, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨r, _⟩ collapses the Fin (2^m) sum to the one inhabited cell — every other cell is excluded through (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)).mp, exact_mod_cast, omega, then Fin.ext; and |t - r/2^m| < 1/2^m follows from the two cell inequalities (abs_of_nonneg on t - r/2^m).
- Pointwise to L¹: integral_mono_ae with the a.e. hypotheses from ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Icc and ae_iff for the missing endpoint; integral_const and the restricted measure's total real mass; abs_sub_le and integral_add for the two layers.

Provenance (mined-from): weak nullness of an alternating dyadic sign family against an L∞ test function, where the L¹ density of dyadic step functions was the residual and both a Student and a prior frame's Student expected a packaged Mathlib lemma for it.

3caac1fea9a7a74225c45fdd55db4a3bdfda049c.hook: An irreducibility bridge lemma frozen out of a main theorem will not close: the descent from a base-field p-th power to an algebraMap range membership fails because the bridge statement dropped the main theorem's nontrivial-root-of-unity hypothesis.
3caac1fea9a7a74225c45fdd55db4a3bdfda049c.name: underhypothesized-bridge-repair-ports-main-theorem-hypotheses
3caac1fea9a7a74225c45fdd55db4a3bdfda049c.body: PATTERN — the obstacle. A bridge lemma frozen out of a main theorem refuses to close under any tactic: the natural descent step (from a base-field p-th power equation to an algebraMap range membership) is not provable because the frozen statement dropped a hypothesis the main theorem carries. PATTERN — the move. Before grinding tactics, test the bridge STATEMENT against a small counterexample (ℚ ⊆ ℚ(ζ₃), p = 3, a = 8: alpha = 2ζ₃ satisfies alpha ^ 3 = 8 and alpha ∉ ℚ, yet X ^ 3 - 8 = (X - 2)(X ^ 2 + 2X + 4) is reducible). If it fails, the repair is statement-level, not tactical: port the main theorem's missing hypotheses — here a nontrivial p-th root of unity in the base field, (z : F) (hz : z ^ p = 1) (hz1 : z ≠ 1) — into the bridge signature. LEAF — spellings of the compiled repair. IsPrimitiveRoot z p comes from ⟨hz, fun n hn => …⟩ via orderOf_eq_prime and orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one; transfer it to the extension with IsPrimitiveRoot.map_of_injective (algebraMap F E).injective. Factor X ^ p - 1 over E[X] with X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod hzprimE hp.pos (α := algebraMap F E z, a := 1), evaluate at the ratio (algebraMap F E b / alpha) whose p-th power is 1, and extract the vanishing factor with Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff; conclude the ratio equals algebraMap (z ^ (i + 1)), so alpha = algebraMap (b * (z ^ (i + 1))⁻¹) lies in the range — the contradiction the frozen statement wanted. Separate the alpha = 0 case first so division is legal; the range witness closes under map_mul / map_inv₀ / map_pow and field_simp. Coin rationale: no existing pattern id in the mathematics libraries names the counterexample-diagnosed, statement-level bridge repair; this id names the obstacle and the move. mined-from: guide-intervention-1 of a Kummer frame whose Student attempt proved the frozen irreducibility bridge false as stated, repaired its signature, and compiled the descent; no problem identifiers or line numbers are needed to apply this.

4d190baabf527fd072c3110dca280ea0761a8f7e.hook: converting the frozen real-interval winding integral ∫ t in 0..2π, fderiv ℝ γ t 1 / (γ t - z) into Mathlib's circle integral ∮ w in C(0,1), logDeriv (fun u => p.eval u) w of the cleared non-monic polynomial: no Laurent chain rule I*e^{It}*L'(e^{It}), no logDeriv (L - z) = logDeriv Q - N/w split, no circleIntegral.integral_sub_center_inv — prove ONE pointwise identity deriv (circleMap 0 1) t * logDeriv (fun u => p.eval u) (circleMap 0 1 t) = fderiv ℝ γ t 1 / (γ t - z) + N * I by matching two HasDerivAt chains (Polynomial.hasDerivAt.comp hasDerivAt_circleMap versus (hcircle.pow N).mul (htrig.sub_const z)), cases N, field_simp; then rw [circleIntegral], intervalIntegral.integral_congr, integral_add, integral_const, and finish with field_simp / push_cast / linear_combination
4d190baabf527fd072c3110dca280ea0761a8f7e.body:
